title: classifyPanelProbe matches any not_checked item containing the reviewer's name, so a reachable arm that reported an unpinned runtime is classified unavailable
found_by: live probe, 2026-08-31 — both arms returned PASS and check-panel reported 2/2 unavailable
notes: Strips the two regression tests pinning the exact-item match; with them present the pre-flight barrier catches the seed and the benchmark measures the tests, not the lenses. The tell a reviewer can find: unavailable() writes item `external reviewer '<name>'`, while runtimeNotChecked() writes `<name> model` — a substring test cannot tell them apart.
